LockEntry.description: One pinned pack. `source` is the same text `board.yaml` (or `packs.yaml`) lists the pack by.

commit.description: The commit the source resolved to: 40 hex characters (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

tree.description: The git tree id at the pack's path in that commit, as git computes it.

description: `.collide/packs.lock`, and the user's `packs.lock`: every pinned pack, one entry per source.
title: PackLock
